data.title: 萝丝 · 断桥残垣的代号666之刃
data.description: 寒夜崩塌的石桥断裂边缘，下方是万丈深渊。代号666的萝丝单膝着地稳定身形，纯黑细剑在身侧划出一道银色弧光，随时准备向敌阵突进。
data.location: broken stone viaduct ruins over mist-shrouded chasm under full moon
data.action: crouched dynamically on fractured bridge masonry, drawn slime rapier pointed forward, combat cape flaring in wind, sharp tactical gaze
data.lighting: 冷月高光与魔力细剑反光
data.promptProse: Number 666 Rose crouches low on a shattered stone aqueduct in the moonlight, rapier leveled forward with steely concentration.
data.animaCaption: Full moonlight outlines her combat posture against the dark abyss below.
